Industrial Products · 01

HDPE Fittings

HDPE fittings join polyethylene pipe by butt fusion or by flanged connection. They are used in water and wastewater, mining and slurry lines, dewatering, irrigation and industrial process piping where corrosion resistance, toughness and low weight matter. Stub ends and flanges connect HDPE pipe to valves, pumps and steel pipework.
